how_to_apply: The online application process has 3 stages:
Stage 1 – Online Registration: Complete basic registration. No corrections are possible after submitting Stage 1.

Stage 2 – Detailed Application Form Filling: Enter personal details, qualification, employment details, responsible officer information, and upload documents. This can be edited until online fee payment.

Stage 3 – Fee Payment & Final Submission: Take a printout of the filled Stage 2 form and verify all details carefully before proceeding - no corrections are allowed after fee payment and final submission.
Valid Photo ID (PAN Card / Aadhaar Card / Driving Licence / Voter ID / Passport)
Valid Permanent Rajasthan State Medical Council (RMC) Registration*
Internship Completion Certificate (or a letter from the Principal/Controller of the concerned medical college mentioning the expected completion date, if internship is ongoing)
Scanned passport-size photograph (50KB–200KB, JPEG/JPG) plus a live photo captured via webcam

*If the Permanent RMC registration certificate is unavailable at the time of application, it must be uploaded within 2 days after the examination date - but its date of issue must be on or before the examination date, or the candidate will not be eligible.
important_instructions: Appearing in the exam does not by itself give a candidate the right to eligibility - final eligibility is decided only after document verification and confirmation of all criteria by the Government of Rajasthan committee. Legal issues challenging the examination process are the responsibility of RUHS; issues relating to eligibility, reservation, and recruitment are the responsibility of the Government of Rajasthan. A candidate can submit the MODRE-2026 application only once - submitting more than one application form may lead to debarment and cancellation of candidature. RUHS will not entertain any request for change in the information provided by the candidate under any circumstances, once submitted. Application for MODRE-2026 can only be submitted online through www.ruhsraj.org - there is no other method of submission or fee deposit. Candidates trying to use unfair means will be disqualified from the recruitment, with no correspondence entertained. In case of any dispute, the jurisdiction will be the Hon'ble Rajasthan High Court only. The decision of RUHS in all aspects pertaining to the application, examination conduct, and all consequent stages is final and binding on all concerned. RUHS reserves the right to alter or modify the timelines and conditions of this notification as warranted by unforeseen circumstances, with updates published on the RUHS website.

content_sections.heading: RUHS MODRE 2026 Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: There are 600 total vacancies for Medical Officer (Medical), distributed category-wise as below. The number of vacancies may be increased or decreased by the appointing authority as needed. Additional horizontal reservation is provided: 4% for Special/PwBD candidates (24 posts in the new recruitment) and 5% for Ex-Servicemen candidates, distributed across UR/EWS/BC/SC/ST/MBC categories. Within posts reserved for women, 8% are reserved for widows and 2% for divorced/separated women; if unavailable, these are filled by general women of the same category. Out of the 24 PwBD-suitable posts for Medical Officer, the benchmark disability categories identified as suitable include One Arm, One Leg, Both Legs, Leprosy Cured, Dwarfism, Acid Attack Victims, Specific Learning Disability, and Multiple Disabilities (as per the relevant categories). Important: Candidates who are Non-Bonafide Residents of Rajasthan will be treated as Unreserved (UR) and will not get any reservation benefit for age, category, or fee relaxation.

content_sections.heading: RUHS MODRE 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Essential Qualification: M.B.B.S. As per Personnel Department notification No. F-03(7)DOP/A-II/97 dated 17.09.1999, registration with the Rajasthan Medical Council (RMC) is mandatory as on the date of the written examination. If Permanent RMC registration is not available at the time of filling the online application, it must be uploaded within 2 days after the date of examination - but its date of issue must be on or before the examination date. Preferred qualification: Practical knowledge of Hindi written in Devanagari script and knowledge of Rajasthan's culture. Indian citizens or Overseas Citizens of India who obtained their Primary Medical Qualification from a medical college outside India must have qualified the Foreign Medical Graduate Examination (Screening Test) as per the Screening Test Regulations 2002 (as amended), conducted by the National Board of Examinations in Medical Sciences. They must also have obtained a Permanent Registration Certificate from the Rajasthan Medical Council (RMC), Jaipur, on or before the date of the MODRE-2026 examination. As per Personnel Department notification dated 08.04.2003, a candidate with more than two children on or after 01.06.2002 is not eligible for appointment. Candidates who are married must provide marriage registration information at the time of joining, as per the circular dated 30.06.2006. Candidates with more than one spouse (bigamy) are not eligible for this recruitment. Candidates who have taken or given dowry at the time of their marriage are not eligible for this recruitment. Before joining, candidates must submit a health certificate and police character verification from the concerned Superintendent of Police.

content_sections.heading: RUHS MODRE 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: Minimum age is 22 years and maximum age is 45 years, as on 01.01.2027. As the Department last issued a notification for this recruitment in 2024 through RUHS, additional age relaxation is payable as per the Personnel Department notification dated 23.09.2008. Age relaxation for reserved category candidates of Rajasthan is applicable as per State Government rules (Arthana and letters on the RUHS website); non-bonafide residents of Rajasthan are treated as UR and are not eligible for any age relaxation. Candidates are advised to check whether they satisfy the prescribed age limit before applying. Use our online Age Calculator to calculate your exact age instantly.

content_sections.heading: RUHS MODRE 2026 Exam Pattern & Syllabus
content_sections.text: MODRE-2026 will be conducted OFFLINE in OMR-based mode . The question paper comprises 100 Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs) of 1 mark each . Duration: 2 hours (120 minutes) . There is no negative marking. The examination will be conducted in English language only . The exam centre will preferably be at Jaipur; RUHS reserves the right to create additional cities/centres. Syllabus: The syllabus comprises all subjects studied by an MBBS graduate during the four-and-a-half-year curriculum as prescribed by the National Medical Commission (NMC) or the competent authority. MODRE-2026 is an eligibility-cum-ranking examination - RUHS is responsible only for conducting the exam, declaring the result, and handing it over to the designated recruitment authority. Document verification and final eligibility determination is carried out by that authority (Government of Rajasthan), not RUHS.

faq.question: Q1. What is RUHS Medical Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by the Rajasthan University of Health Sciences for 600 Medical Officer (Medical) posts under the Medical, Health & Family Welfare Department, Government of Rajasthan.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in RUHS Medical Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: 600 posts in total, distributed across UR, EWS, BC, SC, ST, and MBC categories, with sub-reservation for women and horizontal reservation for PwD and ex-servicemen candidates.

faq.question: Q3. When can I apply for RUHS Medical Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application form will be available from 14 September 2026 to 13 October 2026 on www.ruhsraj.org. It is not open yet as of this notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for RUHS Medical Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: MBBS is mandatory, along with valid Rajasthan Medical Council registration by the date of the written examination. Further qualification/experience details will be in the detailed Information Booklet.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for Medical Officer (Medical) posts under MODRE 2026?
faq.answer: The pay scale is ₹15,600–₹39,100 (Pay Level 14), with approximate total monthly emoluments of ₹56,700 (current basic pay of ₹39,300 plus Medical Care Allowance of ₹17,400) during the probation period.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply online for RUHS MODRE 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply only through www.ruhsraj.org in three stages - Online Registration, Detailed Application Form filling, and Fee Payment with Final Submission - before the closing date of 13.10.2026.

faq.question: Q7. Is Permanent RMC registration mandatory for RUHS MODRE 2026?
faq.answer: Yes. Permanent Rajasthan Medical Council (RMC) registration is mandatory as on the date of the written examination. If not available at the time of application, it must be uploaded within 2 days after the exam, but its issue date must still be on or before the examination date.

faq.question: Q8. What is the application fee for RUHS MODRE 2026?
faq.answer: The fee is ₹5,000 for general candidates and ₹2,500 for SC/ST candidates of Rajasthan State, plus applicable bank/card charges. It is non-refundable and non-transferable.

faq.question: Q9. What is the exam pattern for RUHS MODRE 2026?
faq.answer: MODRE-2026 is an offline, OMR-based exam with 100 MCQs of 1 mark each, for a duration of 2 hours (120 minutes), conducted in English only, with no negative marking.

faq.question: Q10. What is the age limit for RUHS MODRE 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be minimum 22 years and maximum 45 years of age as on 01.01.2027, with relaxation up to 10 years for reserved-category women of Rajasthan and a maximum age of 50 years for Ex-Servicemen; there is no maximum age limit for widows and separated women.
